title: makeup.land
description: Israeli cosmetics retailer: ΔE shade matching, customer wallet, cart, orders, gift cards.
summary: Israeli cosmetics retailer: ΔE shade matching, customer wallet, cart, orders, gift cards.
offersHint: Israeli cosmetics retailer: ΔE shade matching, customer wallet, cart, orders, gift cards. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://makeup.land/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_products
toolsPreview.description: Browse the catalog with tag, brand, near_hex (ΔE shade match), hue_family, and sort filters. Bearer becomes required when passing `phone` (rewards projection).

toolsPreview.name: list_brands
toolsPreview.description: Return every brand with product counts and slugs. Bearer required.

toolsPreview.name: validate_gift_card
toolsPreview.description: Check a gift card's remaining balance using its code. Public endpoint — no bearer required (gated on knowledge of the code).

toolsPreview.name: get_customer
toolsPreview.description: Return tags, ℳ-credit balance, M Club tier for the customer with the given E.164 phone. Bearer required.

toolsPreview.name: get_cart
toolsPreview.description: Return the customer's most-recently-updated cart with per-line and total reward projection. Bearer + phone required.

toolsPreview.name: list_orders
toolsPreview.description: Recent orders with 6-axis status (order / payment / fulfillment / delivery / return / review). Bearer + phone required.

toolsPreview.name: list_payment_links
toolsPreview.description: Pending payment_requests on the customer's unpaid orders. Bearer + phone required.

toolsPreview.name: get_customer_best_deals
toolsPreview.description: Top deal projections based on the customer's tags + M Club tier. Bearer + phone required.
